title: Turn-taking gap
summary: Across ten languages, the mean offset from a polar question to its answer is about 208 milliseconds.
body: Stivers, Enfield, and colleagues measured turn-taking in conversation. Across ten languages the mean offset from a polar question to its answer is +208 ms. Each language's mode sits between 0 and +200 ms. This card is a sample for the memory index, not a substitute for the paper.

sources.title: Stivers et al., Universals and cultural variation in turn-taking in conversation, PNAS 2009
sources.author: Tanya Stivers and colleagues
